title: Black ball of no light formed by the emitter
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Black ball of no light formed by the emitter, about late 1980s at S4, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it made a little black ball in the air where no light was escaping looking like a little black hole.

And then rotated the emitter. I don't know if it was another direction or more the same way, but it made a little black ball in the air where no light was escape escaping looking like a little black hole
tellings.difference: Adds that the emitter was rotated to make the ball.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Lazar's firsthand account of the S-4 emitter making a little black ball where no light escaped.

as_told.title: Lazar's reactor emitter creates a little black ball

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in the late 1980s at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, told this to podcast host Jesse Michels. He says that when a part of the craft he calls the emitter was turned, it made a little black ball in the air from which no light escaped, like a tiny black hole, and he mentions a man named Barry Castilio. If true, it would mean the craft could bend light and space in ways no known machine can.
